name: orpheus
description: Spec-driven development orchestrator for Merkurial-studio. v3.0 re-platforms from Antigravity to the Claude ecosystem (Claude Code + Cowork): the five Commands and Protocols ship as one installable plugin, ending per-project fan-out. Manages per-project conductor/ state — consolidated identity, domain glossary, batched ADRs, living PRD, dynamic index sync, and domain-aware tracks.
